paragraphs.source_en: Some scenes from the television commercial that launched the Milk Duds "long lasting" position. Unfortunately the chairman didn't like the Big Mouth and killed the program. Milk Duds went back to the movies. Let's take a mental walk through a 30second TV commercial to see how the longlasting idea was sugarcoated for the benefit of the 10yearold. 1. Once there was a kid who had a big mouth . . . (A kid is standing next to an enormous mouth.) 2. . . . that loved candy bars. (The kid is shoveling candy bars one right after another into the mouth.) 3. . . . but they didn't last very long. (The kid runs out of candy bars and the mouth gets very upset.) 4. Then he discovered chocolaty caramel Milk Duds. (The kid holds up the Milk Duds, and the mouth starts to lick its chops.) 5. The mouth loved the Milk Duds because they last a long time.
